svg.title: Architecture — three places with clear responsibilities
svg.desc: The browser owns the screen and current conversation. The app server owns requests, AI tools, and SQL checks. PostgreSQL stores the queried data, while a separate AI provider receives model requests. Startup checks and saved schema information support these core responsibilities.
